IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF MULTNOMAH COUNTY, OREGON
Case No. 24CV11873

MARGARET SMITH, Plaintiff,
v.
THOMAS JONES, Defendant.

DEFENDANT'S ANSWER AND AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES

Defendant admits the parties entered an agreement dated Jan 5, 2024,
denies the cabinetry was non-conforming, and asserts that Plaintiff
materially changed the specification after fabrication had begun.
